prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Specify an icon family for a journaling app across iPhone and Mac. Read interface.md. Produce a concrete revised interaction specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iOS/macOS. Marketing supplied a screenshot with tiny tagline text, simulated platform corner mask, baked-in drop shadow and a seasonal badge occupying half the mark. No final artwork exists.

criteria.task_completion: Create a reproducible icon art brief with recognizable simple form, platform-specific asset treatments and small-size/light/dark checks; avoid hardcoding one platform’s mask into every source asset.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the app-icons guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Create a reproducible icon art brief with recognizable simple form, platform-specific asset treatments and small-size/light/dark checks; avoid hardcoding one platform’s mask into every source asset.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Create a reproducible icon art brief with recognizable simple form, platform-specific asset treatments and small-size/light/dark checks; avoid hardcoding one platform’s mask into every source asset.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
